question: Does the frozen HD-PLF action value predict B2 source discrimination gain from an actual future concentration observation?
target_support: All 6 sources x 4 fresh OPEN target realizations per environment, no outcome-based selection
source_hypotheses: The existing six OPEN source templates; full Native support and aligned Native runtime q are unavailable for these target episodes
action_weights: Uniform 1/6 over the same six source hypotheses for both arms, explicitly a diagnostic substitute for Native q
anchor_rule: For each target, scan times 0 through 8 then frozen probe rank 1 through 30 and take the first strictly positive pooled concentration; omit and count only if no such event exists or there are fewer than two feasible local goals
history: One actual positive pooled reading at the selected frozen probe and its nearest coarse-grid memory cell
future_observation: At the next frozen time snapshot, sample the retained raw concentration cube at each geometry-feasible coarse goal by an area-average 0.20 m by 0.20 m square centered on that goal; no interpolation in time
target_data_boundary: Future values and source identity are used only to evaluate goals after model-only action values are frozen; the action function receives neither
observation_projection_check: The same square operator at all 30 frozen probe centers must reproduce stored pooled.npy within 1e-5 absolute concentration units
model_action: Call the existing HDPLFActionSelector with unchanged u/rawu mean maps, uniform six-source q, first-positive anchor memory cell, and identical feasible goals. Preserve 0.60-1.20 m radius, 2.70 m path limit, and 0.01/m movement penalty
evidence_score: For each arm and goal, perform the existing nonnegative-gain B2 profile SSE on the two observations [anchor, future goal] with the same arm templates. One-observation prefix is scored with the same B2 rule
primary_gain: Tie-aware true-source rank gain: expected rank under uniform tie breaking before minus after; SSE tie tolerance is 1e-10 * max(1, squared observed-vector norm)
secondary_gain: Change in raw true-source versus best competing-source B2 SSE margin: [min wrong SSE - truth SSE] after minus before, with no observation-norm normalization
association: Within each target episode, Spearman correlation across all feasible goals between frozen action value and each observation-grounded gain. Undefined correlations are reported and excluded, never set to zero. Summarize by environment and source, not by treating all goals as independent samples
selected_goal_check: Compare each arm's selected goal gain with the median gain over the same feasible goals, without choosing a goal using target values
inference_limit: This is a six-source counterfactual cube audit with frozen snapshot spacing and synthetic uniform q. B2 SSE is not converted into a calibrated posterior. It does not establish Native posterior coupling, VGR execution, or a full-support deployment benefit
amendment_provenance: User clarified before any action-validity score or rank was computed that the secondary outcome must be raw B2 truth-vs-best-wrong SSE margin and no calibrated posterior may be constructed. One retained cube's shape, range, and metadata had been inspected solely for the spatial contract; no action-validity outcome had been computed.
prohibited: changing the existing action function during this audit
